answer: Correlated-behaviour clustering: the ledger compares agents' answer timing, wording and attestation patterns, and any cluster that moves in lockstep shares one reward cap. The farmer pays: each fake must be run with its own model, schedule and voice to look independent, so operating cost grows per identity. Failure case: a farm hiding in a walled garden of mutual attestations finds no safe haven, since the overlap is visible on the horizon of the whole graph.
